prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Runtime resource icon atlas for a top-down anime pixel-art JRPG inspired by Tempest. Square image, EXACT 3 columns by 3 rows of equal square cells. Nine individually isolated objects, each no larger than 60 percent of its own cell size, centered with generous empty margins. SAME rich anime pixel style as the game's item atlas: dark crisp outlines, visible pixel clusters, vivid cel shading, hard highlights. TRUE alpha transparent background. No words, letters, numbers, frame, gridlines, scenery or shadows beyond the object. Row major exact order:
ROW1: bundle of warm brown timber logs tied with rope; chunky slate-silver raw iron ore with rusty flecks; violet-blue magical ore rocks threaded with cyan veins.
ROW2: spool of ivory monster silk thread; rolled thick caramel-brown beast leather hide; two curved ivory wolf fangs tied with dark leather.
ROW3: bundle of fresh green healing herbs with tiny pink flowers; cluster of luminous cyan and amethyst magical crystals; three overlapping deep emerald and gold ancient serpent scales.
All nine designs clearly distinct and readable at 48px. Preserve pure transparent empty space between sprites. Reference image only defines anime pixel edge, material shading and color treatment, not a request to repeat equipment.
